memories.author: D04
memories.text:
- NAFLD: Patient reports mild right upper quadrant discomfort, no jaundice. Weight 78 kg, waist 92 cm (above male cut‑off 90 cm). Status: stable, LFTs pending. Plan: Start silymarin 140 mg TDS, rosuvastatin 5 mg OD; advise low‑fat diet, avoid alcohol; arrange abdominal ultrasound and LFT.
- Generalised anxiety disorder: Patient describes occasional worry, sleep disturbance. Status: mild. Plan: Start escitalopram 5 mg OD, buspirone 5 mg BD; advise relaxation techniques; schedule GAD‑7.
Due: HbA1c repeat in 3 months (2025-07-05).

- Generalised anxiety disorder: Patient notes occasional anxiety, sleep okay. GAD‑7 score 6 (mild). Status: stable. Plan: Continue escitalopram 5 mg OD, buspirone 5 mg BD; reinforce CBT techniques.
Due: HbA1c repeat in 3 months (2025-10-10).

memories.author: patient
memories.text: Over the past month I’ve felt more anxious, especially in the mornings before opening the shop. I worry about sales and feel restless. Sleep is disturbed, I wake up 2‑3 times. My GAD‑7 score today is 10 (moderate). I also notice a slight heaviness in the right upper abdomen after meals.

memories.author: D04
memories.text:
- NAFLD: Patient reports mild post‑prandial heaviness, weight 76 kg, waist 88 cm (below cut‑off). LFTs stable. Status: stable. Plan: Continue silymarin 140 mg TDS, rosuvastatin 5 mg OD; repeat ultrasound in 6 months.
- Generalised anxiety disorder: Patient describes increased anxiety, GAD‑7 10 (moderate), sleep disturbance. Status: worsened. Plan: Increase escitalopram to 10 mg OD, increase buspirone to 10 mg BD; add brief CBT referral; monitor for side effects.
Due: HbA1c repeat in 3 months (2026-01-05).

memories.author: D04
memories.text:
To: Dr. Suman Rao, Psychiatrist, Bengaluru.
Reason: Generalised anxiety disorder, moderate severity (GAD‑7 10), inadequate response to current escitalopram/buspirone dose.
Request: Evaluation, consideration of psychotherapy, possible medication adjustment.
Enclosed: Recent visit note, GAD‑7 score, medication list.

memories.author: D04
memories.text: From Dr. Suman Rao, Psychiatrist: Patient evaluated on 2026-01-20. Diagnosis: Generalised anxiety disorder, moderate. Recommended: Continue escitalopram 10 mg OD, add CBT weekly for 8 weeks. Buspirone may be tapered if anxiety improves. Follow‑up in 4 weeks. No adverse effects reported. Patient engaged well with therapy.
